question: Does the bounded receiver-side change (moving the fitted word-contrast write from the original three-layer mid band to one early layer at relative depth 0.2, raw scale, gamma 1) let the FROZEN automatic word-index sender deliver facts on receivers that previously failed, on a bank of unseen evidence constructions and names?

sender.identity: candidate A, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, prompt/parse/weights/ordering unchanged from a dated decision record

selected_configuration.rule: raw fitted word-contrast write at relative depth 0.2, gamma 1, four public slot positions per object
selected_configuration.provenance: chosen on R1/R2 development by the pre-declared rule (largest development J with coverage >= 0.90 across the R1 raw cells and the five R2 local cells; ties -> higher U, fewer layers, raw scale, smaller gamma, R1 order); identical choice for all four receivers; the generic local-scale rule never advanced a cell
selected_configuration.gemma_presearch_rule: gates/receiver_recovery/r2_gemma_presearch_rule.lock.json — frozen from native development only before any Gemma fitted cell was read; it selects the same depth, so selected == pre-search rule up to the scale factor c=1.028, and both are reported

conditions.6 the other world's independently genera: actual/other_world, scored against both the current and the supplied gold

endpoints.primary: scene-level four-answer joint correctness J at the 64-token budget, all 572 development scenes in the denominator (4 engineering scenes excluded)

multiplicity.family: six tests: {selected-original, selected-mean-reassignment} x {qwen3-14b-base, glm-4-9b, gemma-3-27b-it}
multiplicity.method: Holm, familywise alpha 0.05, two-sided paired bootstrap p
multiplicity.anchor: qwen3-32b is the retained successful anchor and is NOT in the family; its rows are reported
multiplicity.note: identical selected/original configurations would receive p=1; none are identical here

ci.method: scene-paired cluster bootstrap of cluster means, 20000 draws x seeds [190919,290919,390919], envelope = min lower / max upper
ci.rule: both levels reported; a claimed improvement needs the paired estimate and its 95% interval lower bound positive

targets.useful_additional_receiver: selected automatic J >= 0.50 AND strict coverage >= 0.90 AND selected - mean reassignment positive with interval lower bound > 0 and Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05
targets.substantial_recovery: additionally selected - original >= +0.20 with the same interval and adjusted-p requirements
targets.note: these are this campaign targets, not publication standards; raw magnitudes and every criterion are reported even when a clause fails

not_claims: no-message J = 0 is structural for identical deterministic receiver inputs across the two worlds and is not evidence of communication
other-world rows are repeated measures on the same scenes and add no independent N
no text superiority or noninferiority claim follows from an insignificant contrast
native transplantation reads scene-specific states and is an instrument, not a deployable map-free method
evaluated_once: One evaluation of this bank per receiver; no re-selection, no threshold movement, no prompt or dose search here.
